description: Source code for a Git credential helper using libsecret to store and retrieve credentials from GNOME Keyring/Secret Service. Implements credential operations: get, store, erase, with functions for reading/writing credentials and interacting with the secret service.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Resets all fields of a credential struct to default values.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin, parsing key=value lines into a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Outputs credential data (username, password, etc.) to stdout.

methods.name: make_label
methods.description: Creates a label string for the credential, used as a label in the secret store.

methods.name: make_attr_list
methods.description: Creates a hash table of attributes for searching/storing credentials in the secret service.

methods.name: keyring_get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from the secret service based on provided credential info.

methods.name: keyring_store
methods.description: Stores credentials into the secret service.

methods.name: keyring_erase
methods.description: Erases credentials from the secret service.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the credential helper command.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments and executing credential operations.
